title: Chapter 383: Kong'S Strength
content:
Chapter 383: Kong'S Strength

In this way, the three tribe leaders who are always arrogant and strategist have become silent.

After several days, I couldn't speak.

Because they really can't figure out what the human race thinks.

And within the human race.

The incident of killing the three elders of the God Clan in one breath has long been spreading.

Everyone looked excited and excited.

For a moment, everyone even forgot the deterrence of the terrifying monster on the border.

After a brief period of excitement, the top leaders of the human race reacted one after another.

Whenever they wanted to ask Lu Xuezhi, they were sent off by An Changzai and the other two.

"Can we really have to sit and wait for death?"

The human strong man sighed slightly.

The rest of them remained silent.

In the ancestral land of the human race, Lu Xue has been sitting cross-legged here for a long time.

An Changzai and the other three were waiting quietly outside.

Dong, Dong, Dong.

This day came after all.

An Changzai slowly opened his sharp eyes and looked towards the direction of the border.

"Here you."

Wu Shang had already stood up, his face was a little solemn, but there was no trace of fear in his eyes.

Huo Xingzhi was still lying flat on the ground. He opened his eyes casually and looked at the dim sky, as if muttering to himself, "The world is really far away."

Rumble!

A huge roar echoed.

At this moment, the creatures in the Chaos Realm felt a strong deterrent force.

At the boundary.

A huge dark monster slowly stepped out of the border.

Every step you take, the endless corrosive aura comes to you.

Everything around was darkened.

Even the Supreme Law can't suppress this dark aura.

It is visible to the naked eye that the supreme law is rapidly weakening.

It turned out that this monster was not sleeping, he was just waiting, and even the Supreme Law had no ability to stop him.

By then, the entire Chaos Realm will be swallowed by him.

The dark green eyes looked ahead, with the direction of the human race in their eyes.

"Human race."

The rich greed flowed out from his eyes.

......

The deserted city.

An Xing stood on the city wall, looking into the distance, with dark light flowing in his eyes.

"It seems that we still need to use the backup plan left by the Lord of the City."

On the side, Huang Shou stood with his sword in his arms, and said calmly: "But the Lord of the City has an order, and it can only be used when the city is in danger."

"Now, the monster's target is not us."

"Is there a difference?"

An Xing frowned and said, "This monster is ambitious. Do you think we can avoid it?"

Huang Shou said nothing.

At this time, An Xing continued, "The most important thing is Miss. If we don't help the lady now, what do you think the lady will think."

"With the lady's temperament, even eight horses can't be pulled back by then."

An Xing still remembers what Lu Xue said when she left that day.

I don’t know where the city lord went, but he still didn’t come back to save it.

An Xing shook his head slightly, turned his head to look at Huang Shou, and then whispered: "I'd better go and ask Viagra."

After the words came, An Xing left.

Huang Shou stood there, silent for a long time, but the sword in his hand was holding it a little harder.

"My little master, let's go back to the deserted city first to hide. That monster is not good!"

Ao Qing said anxiously beside Lu Xue.

He was already a little panicked when he looked at the terrifying aura that was getting closer and closer in the distance.

With the current human strength, it is probably a fantasy to stop that monster.

Unless An Changzai and the three of them ignore the consequences and use power that does not belong to this world, they will also kill one thousand enemies and lose eight hundred of them.

By then, the human race will not be able to recover for millions of years.

And it is not certain whether you can beat it or not.

Faced with Ao Qing's suggestion, Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes, her expression was extremely calm.

"What's the panic?"

Lu Xue never looked towards the boundary from beginning to end, and seemed to have never taken the monster seriously.

Ao Qing didn't understand, "My master, can you already have a good plan?"

Then say it quickly, I'm scared to death.

Lu Xue said nothing, but the shadow behind her gradually began to squirm.

"Miss, after being ordered by the city lord, the monster came down and killed."

Kong's figure slowly emerged and spoke respectfully towards Lu Xue.

Looking at Kong, Ao Qing was slightly stunned and then ecstatic.

"Master?! Hahaha, I know, I know."

At this time, Kong's figure began to float until it became boiling. Kong's breath began to surge, and the space around him gradually turned into pitch black.

An Changzai's eyes were immediately attracted by the three of them, with a look of horror in his eyes.

"Is this, incarnation?"

"No, I was the incarnation just now, and now it has come true."

"What a strong aura, even above the palace master's aunt."

Wu Shang and Huo Xingzhi spoke one after another, and their voices were a little heavy.

The palace master's family really doesn't support idle people.

Finally, the breath of hollow gradually calmed down. He bowed slightly to Lu Xue again, and then stepped out in the direction of the border.

The next moment, Kong appeared out of thin air outside the human world.

boom!

The space trembled, and a huge black monster appeared in empty vision.

"Ant, die!"

Facing the sky, there was no slight wave in the monster's eyes.

Similarly, there is nothing left.

I saw Kong slowly lift his palm and then gently push it at the monster.

An indescribable force suddenly surged out of his empty palm.

Dong!

There was another loud bang, and the monster was stunned by the power. He looked at the stars. Before he could react, the sky in the distance had already made movements again.

He raised his palm again, and grabbed it hard in the direction of the monster.

In an instant, the space around the monster changed and became pitch black. At this moment, the monster lost all five senses.

But that dark space has begun to quickly swallow the monster's body.

"Then, who is that?"

"The human race is the strong man of the human race!"

The creatures in the Chaos Realm looked at the figure with a horror.

It only took two moves to subdue the monster. What kind of realm is this!

Seeing this scene, the strong people of the human race were already irritated.

They have even guessed where this mysterious powerful man came from.

It turns out that the Palace Master had already known it.

In the Holy Spirit Clan, the elders of the Holy Spirit Clan looked calm, but the handsome hands hidden behind them were trembling slightly.

And at this time, a sound came into my ears.

Her delicate body trembled slightly, and then she quickly sent an order.

"Come, prepare gifts!"

......

Inside the Heavenly Demon Clan.

"Oh, I'll go!"

"This human race is so fierce!"

Elder White Tiger widened his eyes, his eyes full of disbelief.

He turned his head and looked at Xuan Turtle, "Class leader, don't tell me you've guessed it long ago."

The black turtle smiled, "That city is full of impossible things."

It only took a moment.

Outside the human race, there has been peace.

The human race was not even affected at all.

The monster seemed to have never been here, and there was no trace left.

As for the mysterious strong man, he has long disappeared.
